scope: Four source contracts beyond SE-001..060; source review, not new execution or approved deferral

requirements.requirement: Rental, paid bus stops, parking capacity, traffic signals and junction reservations
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Driving follows directed lanes and same-lane spacing; no rental agreement, transit/parking model, signal or intersection reservation.
requirements.next_action: Mobility module with funded fare/deposit, real capacity/reservations and tests; do not label basic driving as transit.

requirements.requirement: Clear/cloud/rain/wind weather and 0.5x/1x/2x time controls; cosmetic aging
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Day/night tint and a fixed clock exist. No weather state or user rate command/UI; age is static. Clock ratio conflicts are already documented in ADR2.
requirements.next_action: Add deterministic weather and recorded speed controls preserving fixed simulation tick; distinguish cosmetic age from demographic death.

requirements.requirement: Player heavy attack and dodge controls
requirements.implemented_and_gap: ATTACK heavy and DODGE are implemented in domain; visible keyboard/menu only offers ordinary attack, block and surrender.
requirements.next_action: Expose supported actions through accessible controls and test input-to-result.

requirements.requirement: Daily XP ceiling, perk/unlock progression
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Informal TRAIN capped five/day; all skills bounded100. No global daily XP accounting or perk model across books, course attendance, shifts and social interaction.
requirements.next_action: Define consistent daily gain accounting without claiming TRAIN cap covers every XP source.

requirements.requirement: University lesson, club and school social hierarchy
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Three attended courses/certificates and certificate-gated jobs exist. There is no club/university group membership or hierarchy model.
requirements.next_action: Keep courses as verified; add group/hierarchy interactions or retain this as unmet, not approved deferral.

requirements.requirement: Faction membership/hierarchy, one leader, treasury, rivals, heat, personal loyalty and contested territory
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Three influence flags, player faction and departure event exist. No Gang aggregate or NPC membership/officer/leader/treasury/rivalry state.
requirements.next_action: Typed factions with real funded flows, membership invariants and consequential decisions.

requirements.requirement: False witness reports, limited police knowledge/capacity, separate arrest/custody/acquittal outcomes
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Evidence-backed assault reports, investigating/pursuit/resolved states, fines and surrender exist. No separate police knowledge representation, false-report scenario, dispatch capacity, custody or acquittal. Detailed courtroom procedure is explicitly outside1.0; that does not establish these simpler states.
requirements.next_action: Implement minimum knowledge-limited case outcomes; do not invent detailed court scope.

requirements.requirement: Stolen item provenance and victim inventory bound
requirements.implemented_and_gap: No theft/stolen inventory path is implemented. Ordinary consumables are counted stacks and quest parcels have unique quest IDs. Provenance invariant cannot be claimed tested on absent theft.
requirements.next_action: If theft is introduced, link instance provenance and debit victim inventory. Do not count this as a passing theft system.

requirements.requirement: Guardians, dependents, bounded births/deaths/migration, tombstones and debt-first estates/inheritance
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Adult marriage/separation, deterministic initial families and acyclic ancestry exist. No births/deaths/guardians/dependents or estate events. Initial population remains1100.
requirements.next_action: Extend LifeV2 under schema4, preserve original100local IDs, validate child restrictions and all estate/household references.

requirements.requirement: Rumor source/confidence, repeatable salience decay, critical memories and familiarity/loyalty
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Observer-only event IDs stored; local NPC memory48FIFO, sparse trust/affection/fear/resentment. No rumor, confidence, salience/decay or protected memory; background memories do not receive emit observer entries.
requirements.next_action: Typed memory provenance/decay with protected critical events and tests; retain existing privacy correctness.

requirements.classification: Concrete routine behavior; algorithm is proposal
requirements.requirement: Background scheduled travel arrivals, shop hours/queues, school routines and missed-work consequence
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Local routines/path movement exist. Background NPCs immediately change scene at hourly updates; shop hours/queues/transit capacity absent. NPC salary is daily and does not check actual attended shift. Utility formula/min-heap are proposed mechanisms, not independently required product features.
requirements.next_action: Model causal abstract arrivals/attendance and feasibility; choose implementation independently rather than mimic illustrative utility code.

requirements.requirement: Taxes, resource-constrained production, market demand/stock prices and district indicators
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Paired transfers, external trade, wage affordability, layoffs, benefits, stock replenishment and loan assets exist. Stock additions have no input consumption; weekly prices use seeded jitter; no tax schedule or derived district indicator aggregate.
requirements.next_action: Add actual necessary flows/indicators; avoid claiming a price-random-walk is stock/demand response.

requirements.requirement: Bounded strikes, migration/public works and measurable district shock duration/severity
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Distress reduces wages/revenue; bankruptcy closes jobs; shortages and monthly vacant-rent review exist. No strike reducing output, public works or migration shock registry.
requirements.next_action: State-driven typed shock registry with actual consequences; preserve tested distress/closure behavior.

requirements.requirement: Exclusive participants AND locations, causal unresolved facts, choices/effects/fallback definitions
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Twenty templates and branch tests, issuer lock, funded reward, cooldown and timeout exist. Location locks absent; several triggers are elapsed time or broad flags; template lacks explicit choices/effects/fallback fields, and UI does not expose DECLINE_QUEST.
requirements.next_action: Expose refusal; reserve genuinely exclusive participants/locations; ground missing triggers and schema fields without altering acceptance counts.

requirements.requirement: Inventory slot limit and unique item identity
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Weight limit30 IS implemented. Stack inventory has no ordinary item instance IDs or independent slot limit; quest parcel IDs are unique.
requirements.next_action: Decide fungible stack IDs versus instance identity explicitly; do not report weight capacity missing.

requirements.requirement: Voluntary retirement endpoint without mandatory game over
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Recovery and continued play exist; there is no retirement action/state.
requirements.next_action: Provide reversible/explicit retirement summary semantics; no forced ending.

requirements.requirement: Replayable durable command-journal tail and corrupt-tail quarantine
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Atomic SHA snapshots/current+previous, quarantine, sequential migration journal exist and are tested. Journal stores migration sources only, with no durable command payload log/tail replay or sequence cursor; processed command IDs are deduplication, not replay.
requirements.next_action: Add bounded replay log/checkpoints with exact-once verification, or retain this explicit unmet obligation; schema names alone are not proof.

requirements.requirement: Per-object schemaVersion/updatedTick, separate rules version, immutable profile store, bounded delta projection
requirements.implemented_and_gap: World/envelope/protocol versions exist; most objects lack per-object versions/ticks; person profile/state combined; worker sends bounded full projection called DELTA. Existing guarantees may support an ADR, but no ADR for these exact deviations currently exists.
requirements.next_action: Write justified compatibility ADR or implement relevant version boundaries; do not claim exact field contract was followed.

requirements.requirement: Priority heap, spatial hash, hierarchical routing, route invalidation, offscreen scheduling
requirements.implemented_and_gap: A* with collision and cached graph, fixed bounded scans and near/far update rates work. Spec mechanisms are proposed architecture; priority must be measured behavior/invariants. No evidence for every proposed internal structure.
requirements.next_action: Document architecture choices and measured budget impact; not grounds to demand an unnecessary rewrite.

requirements.requirement: Reduced-fidelity main-thread worker fallback; optional-asset placeholder/retry
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Worker fault pauses/restarts verified snapshot; no main-thread simulation fallback. Atlas load uses a fatal error path rather than demonstrated optional-art placeholder/retry.
requirements.next_action: Implement bounded fallback policies or explicitly retain unmet requirements; safe worker restart is already verified.

requirements.requirement: 10,000-NPC synthetic benchmark; 100,000 random validated commands
requirements.implemented_and_gap: 100000-command seeded boundary fuzz IS implemented and PASS in final simulation log. No10k synthetic benchmark evidence found. 5000–10000 production population is a future target, but the explicit synthetic test still remains.
requirements.next_action: Keep fuzz PASS; run/report10k synthetic workload without claiming10k release population.

requirements.requirement: Two human30-minute playtests; browser native200%zoom; real hidden tab; reference PC/low-end long soak
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Automation and in-game200%scale are not human sessions or native browser zoom. Headless Chromium remains visible when backgrounded. Existing timing reports are local candidate measurements with hardware/contended-run limits.
requirements.next_action: Retain UNVERIFIED until actual required evidence; never substitute simulated ticks or hooks.

requirements.requirement: Combined debt + job loss + wanted + health recovery; all20event branches reload; three livelihoods7days
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Individual aid/loan/job/crime/course and event branch tests exist. This read-only audit has not mapped every combined scenario and three7day paths to immutable exact-source evidence.
requirements.next_action: Link exact current reports or add missing integrated scenarios; do not infer combined route from isolated tests.

requirements.requirement: Immutable preview/providerSHA/CI/rollback, production verification
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Dedicated branch and lock respected. User suspended merge/production; production criteria are intentionally not executed. Preview/CI identity still requires exact finalcommit evidence.
requirements.next_action: Continue isolated PR/preview; no merge or production without later explicit user authorization.

resolved_or_nonmandatory: Audio disabled by explicit project instruction and ADR6; not a forgotten requested audio feature.
1,100 initial population retained; 5k–10k production capacity is a future target, distinct from specified10k synthetic test.
Detailed courtroom procedure, multiple districts, multiplayer and photorealistic3D are expressly outside1.0.
100ms fixed physics/simulation authority,24-minute game day and relation scale decisions are documented ADR2–4, not silently marked implementation failures.
Illustrative interface/folder names and proposed utility weights are not independently product acceptance requirements.
